Streaming chat completion through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint of a local Ollama server, with SSE chunks

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count to 3\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/qwen2:0.5b\",\"stream\":true}") |> Enum.to_list()
IO.inspect(result)
```
